meta.title: Locked garden bed: overgrown bramble hedge, padlocked gate, sign, overgrowth overlay
meta.note: Locked bed = its soil tile darkened (multiply ~0.62, slight blue) + the seamless `overgrowth` tile on top (ground layer) + hedge_h/hedge_v around the perimeter (same anchor conventions as plank_h/plank_v, steps in tileWorldPx; draw over the planks; leave a gap of ~80 world px for the gate) + `gate` (front-on view, so put it on a horizontal edge, preferably the bottom/front edge nearest the open bed) + `sign` beside it. The hedge is ~48 world px tall, so the bed beyond stays visible.
